name: io.github.freeappstore-online/mcp
description: AI agent tools for FreeAppStore: build apps on the SDK Shell, deploy status, SDK docs, app info, platform guide.

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Check GitHub Actions deploy status for any app (last 5 runs)

tools.name: app_info
tools.description: Get live URL, repo, store listing, and up/down status for any app

tools.name: sdk_reference
tools.description: SDK reference. Start with 'shell': wrap every app in <Shell> with a nav item per screen. Then 'components' (every UI component), auth, KV, counters, collections, rooms, proxy, hooks

tools.name: platform_guide
tools.description: Fetch the full SKILLS.md platform guide, followed by the current app-building rules (Shell with nav first)

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List your published apps (requires FAS session token)
